mplate's original transformer classes are still in the file, but `SimpleTransformer` now points to the new 3-parameter model. So the model the harness builds contains only those 3 parameters, and the results CSV records `3.00e+00`.

My first attempt to apply the change was a Python script run through the shell, which was declined, so I made the same change with file edits instead. The snapshot is identical to the working file.

Final model: `interpretable_transformers_lib/HardArgmaxPointer3p.py`
